title: Homeless man's cell death probed
article: The coroner's office and RCMP major crime section are investigating the death of a 41-year-old homeless man while in a cell at the Coquitlam RCMP lockup early Monday.

Police said a guard found George Patterson dead in the cell during a routine check. He had been arrested the night before at Lion's Park in Port Coquitlam for being drunk in public and causing a disturbance, said Cpl. Peter Markgraf.
